scripts.dev: concurrently -n docs,react,vue,vanilla -c cyan,green,magenta,yellow "pnpm dev:docs" "pnpm dev:react" "pnpm dev:vue" "pnpm dev:vanilla"
scripts.build: pnpm build:vanilla && pnpm build:react && pnpm build:vue
scripts.build:docs: pnpm verify:enterprise && node scripts/pro-tgz.mjs && pnpm -C docs build && pnpm verify:pro-leak
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C packages/vanilla typecheck && pnpm -C packages/react typecheck && pnpm -C packages/vue typecheck && pnpm -C docs typecheck && pnpm -C docs/apps/vanilla typecheck && pnpm -C docs/apps/react typecheck && pnpm -C docs/apps/vue typecheck
